title: Every factory client reports its version, and loopctl refuses one older than the set allows

story.i_want_to: tell loopctl my own version on every connection and be refused, with the version I need, when I am older than the release set accepts
story.so_that: a machine left behind by a rollout stops at once with its remedy instead of failing later on a field it does not know

rationale: PRD R7: 'Every client reports its version, and loopctl refuses an incompatible one, as the runner contract does today.' Today only the contract MAJOR is checked, on the runner's join (RunnerContract.cast_join/1 and supported_version/1, runner_contract.ex:3752-3756, :4566-4570); the runner's own build version is never sent, chg sends no version on its signed or bearer requests (chg cli/src/outbox.rs:363-400), and the MCP package's version travels only inside the analytics header x-loopctl-client-context, which must never gate anything (lib/loopctl_web/helpers/client_context.ex:1-14). This story extends the runner contract's check to the release set US-52.7 compiles in, and gives the two HTTP clients a header of their own.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.ReleaseSet.check(component, sent) for component in :runner, :chg and :mcp returns :ok when sent is a semver at or above the component's minimum (newer than version included) and {:error, {:incompatible_client_version, %{component, sent, minimum, version}}} when it is below, unparseable, or nil while minimum is not "unreported"; nil is :ok while minimum is "unreported".

Runner contract 1.34.0: RunnerJoin gains optional runner_version (semver pattern); cast_join/1 refuses a join whose runner_version, or its absence, fails ReleaseSet.check(:runner, _) with reason incompatible_client_version, whose x-connection.error_fields are component, sent and minimum; the code is in the join's error list and in permanent_errors["*"], and priv/runner_contract/v1.json is regenerated with a changelog row.

An admitted join's reply carries release_set (ReleaseSet.set/0) beside contract_version, and GET /api/v1/runners/pool shows each connection's runner_version as joined, null for a runner that sent none; the runner_pool tool's description and mcp-server/README.md row name the field.

LoopctlWeb.Plugs.ClientVersion, first after AuthPathThrottle in the :authenticated pipeline and in the :change_events pipeline, reads x-loopctl-client: <component>/<version>; for runner, chg or mcp it answers 426 with error.code incompatible_client_version, component, sent and minimum when ReleaseSet.check/2 refuses, and halts before any key is resolved; a request without the header, or naming another component, passes unchanged.

The runner sends runner_version (its application vsn) on every join, adds incompatible_client_version to its fatal refusals so it exits with fatal_exit_status/0 rather than rejoining, and after each admitted join writes joined.json (contract_version, runner_version, release_set, joined_at) beside its runs_dir with LoopctlRunner.AtomicFile.

chg sends x-loopctl-client: chg/<CARGO_PKG_VERSION> on every request it makes to loopctl (bearer posts, change events, cursor reads, ledger batches); a 426 is permanent for that run: the outbox does not advance the file's offset, and chg prints the refusal's minimum and 'run release/rollout.sh' once per run.

The MCP server sends x-loopctl-client: mcp/<package version> on every request apiCall makes, and returns a 426 to the tool caller as an error naming the minimum and the remedy (/mcp or a session restart once that version is on npm).
A join payload carrying a property RunnerJoin does not declare is admitted with that property dropped, which is what lets a set-n runner join a set n-1 server; a test pins it.

test_cases.name: check/2 boundaries
preconditions: ReleaseSet.check/3 taking the components map as an injected argument: runner minimum "unreported" version 0.2.0; chg minimum 0.2.0 version 0.3.0
expected_results: runner: ok, ok, ok; chg: error, ok, ok, error, error, each error carrying minimum 0.2.0

test_cases.name: cast_join refuses an old runner and drops an unknown property
preconditions: a valid join payload; components injected with runner minimum 0.2.0

test_cases.name: socket join refusal body and admitted reply; pool shows the version (ChannelCase + ConnCase)
preconditions: an enrolled runner and its token; an orchestrator key; components injected through the socket's assigns
expected_results: {:error, %{reason: "incompatible_client_version", component: "runner", sent: "0.1.0", minimum: _}}; reply has release_set; the pool row has runner_version

test_cases.name: tenant isolation: another tenant's runner version is not in the pool (ConnCase)
preconditions: runners joined in tenants A and B
expected_results: only A's runner and its runner_version

test_cases.name: the plug refuses an old client before auth and passes the rest (ConnCase)
preconditions: components injected through conn private; no key on the first request
steps: GET /api/v1/projects with x-loopctl-client: mcp/0.0.1 and no key
the same with a valid key and mcp/<current>

test_cases.name: runner joins with its version, exits on the refusal, writes joined.json (runner ExUnit against its test Phoenix socket)
preconditions: runner test/support/test_loopctl.ex socket answering per case
expected_results: payload runner_version == Application.spec(:loopctl_runner, :vsn); the fatal exit path is taken, no rejoin; joined.json holds release_set 4 and the versions

test_cases.name: chg sends the header and keeps its offset on 426 (cargo test with a local HTTP stub)
preconditions: a stub server recording headers and answering 426 for the ledger path
steps: chg outbox send against the stub
expected_results: every request carried x-loopctl-client: chg/<version>; state.json offset unchanged; stderr names the minimum once

test_cases.name: MCP sends the header and surfaces 426 (node --test)
steps: call list_projects against a stub answering 426
expected_results: request header x-loopctl-client: mcp/<package.json version>; tool error names minimum and the remedy

technical_notes: Server: RunnerContract @version "1.33.0" at lib/loopctl/api_spec/runner_contract.ex:436 becomes 1.34.0; RunnerJoin schema :845-1030 (required list :849-858); cast_join/1 :3752-3756; supported_version/1 :4566-4570; join errors :3315; error_fields :3346; permanent_errors "*" :3442; the changelog table rows begin at :27. Regenerate the export with mix loopctl.runner_contract (lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.runner_contract.ex). Inject the components map (DI rule, CLAUDE.md) so tests never depend on the committed manifest's numbers.

Channel: LoopctlWeb.RunnerChannel.join/3 at lib/loopctl_web/runner_channel.ex:155-200 (reply :176); refusal shaping LoopctlWeb.RunnerChannel.Refusal.for_join/2 (runner_channel/refusal.ex:47-48 is the unsupported_contract_version clause to mirror). Pool rendering: RunnerController.pool/2 at lib/loopctl_web/controllers/runner_controller.ex:484, schema :271/:359.

Plug: router pipelines :authenticated (lib/loopctl_web/router.ex:39-60) and :change_events (:217-219). It runs before ExtractApiKey so an old client gets the actionable 426, not a 401 it cannot fix. The 426 goes into Loopctl.ApiSpec components.responses beside RateLimitError (lib/loopctl/api_spec.ex:90-96) and into CHANGELOG.md (a new 4xx on existing endpoints). The header is not x-loopctl-client-context: that header is analytics-only by its own contract (client_context.ex:1-14).

Runner: join payload built at runner lib/loopctl_runner/control.ex:436-470 ("contract_version" at :455); @fatal_reasons at :332; fatal_exit_status/0 at :764; AtomicFile at lib/loopctl_runner/atomic_file.ex; runs_dir in Config (config.ex:19). joined.json is read by US-52.10's installer to prove the new release joined.

chg: post_bearer_once/5 at chg cli/src/outbox.rs:363-410 builds the curl argv; the signed change-event and ledger requests at cli/src/events.rs:443, :522, :603 and outbox.rs:669. One function returns the header line, used by every call site.

MCP: apiCall headers at mcp-server/index.js:265-271; SERVER_VERSION from packageVersion() at :118 (mcp-server/lib/mcp-version.js). mcp_version's NEITHER-SIDE-IS-A-GATE paragraph (mcp-version.js:59-60) is rewritten: the server now refuses a package below the set's minimum.

Other HTTP callers (fleet_dash, claude-config's Python client, scripts) send no x-loopctl-client and are never refused; an MCP package older than this story sends none either, so it is not refused, and mcp_version keeps reporting it behind (defaults).
No new table, context, route or MCP tool: one plug on two existing pipelines, one optional contract field, one pool field.
non_goals: Installing the versions the set names on each machine: US-52.10.
Refusing an HTTP client that sends no version header: never (defaults).

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.8.6: a chg run cut off mid-send, or refused, keeps its outbox offset, so the rows are sent on the next run after the upgrade.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.8.1: what is compatible is the release set compiled into the server, never a per-request or per-machine record.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.8.5: a refused runner exits instead of rejoining, so a retry loop cannot hammer the socket; a retried HTTP request gets the same 426 (AC-52.8.4).
failure_modes.slow: n/a: the check is a comparison on the request process with no I/O.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.8.3: which version each connected runner runs is visible in runner_pool, keyed by its connection.

defaults: Refusal code incompatible_client_version, HTTP 426, for socket and HTTP alike (owner may rename).
Header x-loopctl-client: <component>/<version>; requests without it are not factory clients and are never refused.
A client newer than the server's set is admitted, so clients may roll before or after the server.
definition_of_done: After deploy and rollout, runner_pool shows runner_version equal to the manifest's on every connected runner.
A curl-free check from a session: mcp_version reports current, and a story read with any MCP tool succeeds (the header passed the plug).
